suffixes.name: .any

categories.description: Check spell cooldown status.

properties.description: Number of times the spell has been cast (from C_Spell.GetSpellCastCount).

properties.name: blocked
properties.description: Spell is user-blocked: Enabled=false in the spell list, session-blocked via /block, or CD-classified while the global CDs toggle is off. Queued spells bypass the block state. Blocked spells also report remains=99999, ready=0, duration=99999, charges=0 on the regular cooldown.* prefix — use cooldown_bypass.* to see the real CD.

properties.name: is_cooldown
properties.description: Spell is classified as a cooldown (member of cdSpells — either user-marked as CD or in the spec's default cooldown list). Independent of the effective block state; combine with state.cds to distinguish 'blocked via CDs off' (is_cooldown & !state.cds) from 'user-disabled' (blocked & !is_cooldown).

categories.name: Cooldown Bypass
categories.description: Same as cooldown.* but ignores the blocked flag. Returns real cooldown data even when the spell is user-blocked.

properties.name: ready
properties.description: Spell is really off cooldown (ignores blocked state).

properties.name: down
properties.description: Spell is really on cooldown (ignores blocked state).

properties.name: charges_fractional
properties.description: Real charges including partial progress (ignores blocked state).

properties.name: full_recharge_time
properties.description: Real seconds until all charges recovered (ignores blocked state).

properties.name: cast_count
properties.description: Number of times the spell has been cast (from C_Spell.GetSpellCastCount).

properties.name: blocked
properties.description: Same as cooldown.SPELL.blocked — spell is user-blocked.

categories.notes: Use cooldown_bypass when you need the real CD state of a blocked spell (e.g., pooling resources for a CD that is toggled off but might be re-enabled).

Length of the aura this action applies, in seconds. NOT a SimC expression - SimC has no action.X.duration - but upstream APLs use it. Spell exists in the spellbook (exact id, no morph fallback).

categories.name: Target
categories.description: Check properties of the current target.

expressions.description: Target damage absorb as % of max health.
Target heal absorb as % of max health.
Target incoming heals as % of max health.
Target is enemy and not dead.
Comprehensive check: exists, enemy, alive, in combat (PvE).
Target is in line of sight.

Target is moving. Derived from object-manager position deltas, not from Lua: GetUnitSpeed returns a secret number for every unit but the player, so this read false for all units before 2026-08-30. Threshold is 0.5 yd/s (walk is 2.5, run 7.0), which ignores sampling jitter on a parked unit. Requires a world position on the unit; without one it reads false.
Target is not moving. Exact inverse of target.moving.
Seconds target has been moving continuously. 0 while standing.
Seconds target has been standing continuously. 0 while moving. Useful for ground-targeted AoE: wait for the unit to be parked long enough that the cast will land.
Target's speed in yards/sec, from object-manager position deltas. Walk is 2.5, run 7.0.

Yards/sec the gap between you and target is shrinking: positive closing, negative opening. It measures the PAIR, so combine it with the two moving flags to say who is moving — 'target.closing_speed<-1&target.moving&!player.moving' is it fleeing you, 'target.closing_speed<-1&player.moving' is you kiting it. 0 when either side has no world position.
Target is targeting a party/raid member.

EDGE distance in yards: center distance minus both units' combat reach. Correct for spell yard gates — the server likewise adds both reaches to a spell's max range. NOT usable as a melee test (see target.in_melee), and NOT usable for AoE radii or geometry (see target.distance): it is not a metric and clamps at 0.

CENTER distance in yards — no reach subtracted, no clamp. This is the space AoE radii and boss mechanics are measured in, and the only one valid for geometry or clustering. target.distance minus target.range always equals the two combat reaches summed.

True when the target is in melee range, computed as the client does: CENTER distance <= max(reachA + reachB + 4/3, 5.0), plus 1.0 when either unit carries the melee-range flag. Use this instead of comparing target.range to a constant.

Yards still to close before reaching melee: exactly 0 while in melee, positive when short of it, never negative. This is how to express 'N yards away from melee', and it is size-invariant — at max melee target.range reads 4.5 on a small mob but 2.33 on a 9-reach boss, while melee_gap reads 0 on both.
Seconds of cast elapsed required before the shared kick aliases will interrupt this spell. From the per-cast `interrupt_after` field in _casts.yaml; 0 = no gate.

Seconds remaining at or below which the shared kick aliases will interrupt this spell. From the per-cast `interrupt_remains` field in _casts.yaml; 0 = no gate. ANDs with config.interrupt_pct (stricter only); `99` never restricts, the idiom for kick-on-sight. Values below 0.3 never fire — ShouldCastWithTag drops kickable casts with <0.3s left first.
Target is casting a specific spell (dynamic).
Target has buff dispelable by SPELL.

Cycle member's debuff is active OR predicted.
Debuff NOT active on cycle member and NOT predicted.
Debuff remaining on cycle member; returns 9999 during prediction.

categories.notes:
Requires `_pred.yaml` in the rotation directory. Format:
```yaml
predictions:
  12345:        # cast spell ID
    buff: 67890  # effect aura ID (use 'debuff:' for debuffs)
  11111:
    debuff: 22222
```
Prediction hold window: max(ping, 100ms) for pred.buff/debuff; max(ping, 300ms) for pred.cycle variants. Per-member hold — casting on member B never cancels member A's hold.

categories.name: Totems
categories.description: Check totem uptime (Shaman).

categories.name: Minions (Temporary Summons)
categories.description: Guardians/temporary summons you own, tracked by walking the client entity registry. Keyed by NPC id, NOT spell id — creature GUIDs pack the npc id at bits 6..28. These are separate from pet.* (the permanent pet) and from totem.* (totem slots). There is deliberately no .remains: the client stores no lifetime for guardians, so remaining time is declared as (duration - elapsed) via an alias in _common.yaml.

parameters.NPC_ID: Numeric NPC id of the summon (e.g. 27829 Ebon Gargoyle). Names only work if aliased in _common.yaml.

expressions.description: We currently own at least one of this summon.
We own none of this summon.
How many we own. Army of the Dead's 8 ghouls count as 8.

Seconds since the NEWEST one appeared. Returns 0 if it was already alive when the client attached, since its age is unknowable. Prefer this over a declared .remains for anything whose lifetime can be extended in combat.
Seconds since the OLDEST one appeared — the first of a group to expire. Backs the .remains_min aliases.

categories.notes:
Known npc ids: 27829 Ebon Gargoyle (25s) | 237409 Army of the Dead ghoul (30s) | 163366 Magus of the Dead (15s) | 264321 Lord of the Dead (15s) | 221632-221635 the four Riders (10s) | 26125 the permanent DK pet (a Pet- GUID, type 10; guardians are type 8 Creature).
Durations are authored from SimC, not from the summon spell's own duration field — 4 of 8 disagree. Generated for reference by SimC_APL_Reverser/gen_minions.py into _minions.yaml, which is NOT loaded: the live values are hand-copied into the expressions: block of _common.yaml.
_common.yaml provides friendlier aliases: minion.gargoyle.remains, minion.army_ghoul.remains(.remains_min), minion.magus.remains(.remains_min), minion.lord_of_the_dead.remains, plus pet..active forms.
Only npc ids actually referenced by a rotation are collected at parse time and published to the entity walk, so a spec with no minion expressions scans nothing.

categories.name: Equipment & Trinkets
categories.description: Check equipped items, trinket cooldowns, enchants, and set bonuses.

expressions.description: Seconds since trinket 1 was last fired (filtered for item-shared GCD blips — only counts cooldown transitions from 0 to >= 10s). 9999 if never observed.
Seconds since trinket 2 was last fired (filtered for item-shared GCD blips). 9999 if never observed.
Trinket 1 slot holds an equipped item with an on-use effect (ignores cooldown). False for passive trinkets or empty slots.
Trinket 2 slot holds an equipped item with an on-use effect (ignores cooldown).

Use a trinket by name. Resolves item name to ID via ItemSearchName.csv, then checks which slot has it equipped. Automatically suppresses generic trinket_1/trinket_2 for that slot. Name uses SimC snake_case (e.g., algethar_puzzle_box). If trinket is not equipped, the line is a no-op.
Named trinket with explicit condition. The rotation's if= condition overrides _trinkets.yaml conditions for this item.
Main hand is a two-handed weapon.
Set bonus is active (defined in tier_sets).
Specific item is equipped (by numeric ID).
Specific item is equipped (by name, resolved via ItemSearchName.csv). Uses SimC snake_case normalization.
1 when the slot's trinket is equipped, off cooldown, not disabled in _trinkets.yaml, and its burst/condition gates pass. The normal way to fire a generic trinket.
1 when the slot's trinket is off cooldown and not globally disabled. Ignores burst gating.
1 when the slot holds an equipped item with an on-use effect, ignoring cooldown. Distinguishes an on-use trinket from a passive proc.
Seconds remaining on the slot's item cooldown.
Equipped itemId in the slot, 0 when empty.
Seconds since the slot's trinket was last used (9999 if never).

1 while the buff the slot's trinket puts on the player is active. The buff id comes from `trinket_buff:` on that item in _trinkets.yaml; an empty slot, an unlisted trinket, or one with no trinket_buff returns 0.
Seconds left on that trinket buff, 0 when it is down. Use with a `>0` guard, since 0 also means 'no window'.
1 when the named item is equipped in any slot; resolves through the item database.

categories.notes: Every expression exists for both slots — swap trinket_1 / trinket_2. has_buff / buff.remains are the only ones that need data: the item must have a `trinket_buff: <spellId>` entry in _trinkets.yaml. Only on-use trinkets are wired there — aligning a cooldown with the tail of a window you chose to open is a decision; chasing a passive proc's tail is not.

categories.name: Consumables
categories.description: Check consumable cooldowns.

categories.name: Incoming Casts & Aura Lists
categories.description: Unified system for tracking enemy casts (_casts.yaml) and auras (_aura.yaml). Each selector token is a tag, an all-digit spell id, or a normalized spell name (e.g. mind_blast); tokens AND together. The spell must be cataloged in _casts.yaml; id/name just target it without inventing a tag.

groups.name: Incoming Cast (Unit Prefix)
groups.description: Unit prefix specifies which enemy to check. Left-to-right: unit prefix, then incoming_cast, then optional filter (player/cycle), then tags, then property.

expressions.description: Target is casting a spell matching all specified tags.
Target has a matching cast (alias for .up).
Target is NOT casting a matching spell.
Seconds until target's matching cast finishes.
Target is casting a matching spell at the player.
Focus is casting a spell matching all specified tags.
Mouseover is casting a spell matching all specified tags.

groups.name: Incoming Cast (Range Filter)
groups.description: Range filter scans all nameplates within X yards. Supported ranges: 5y, 8y, 10y, 15y, 20y, 25y, 30y, 40y. Only valid without a unit prefix.

expressions.description: Any enemy within X yards is casting a spell matching all tags.
Count of enemies within X yards casting matching spells.
Min remaining seconds of matching casts within X yards.

groups.name: Incoming Cast (No Unit/Filter)
groups.description: Without a unit prefix or filter, scans all enemies within 40y.

expressions.description: Any enemy is casting a spell matching all tags.
No enemy is casting a matching spell.
Min remaining seconds of matching casts (any enemy).
Count of enemies casting matching spells (40y range).

groups.name: Incoming Cast (Target Filter)
groups.description: Filter by who the cast is targeting. player = targeting the player, cycle = targeting current cycle member. Goes after incoming_cast as a filter segment.

expressions.description: Any enemy casting a matching spell targeting the player.
Min remaining seconds of matching casts targeting the player.
Enemy casting a matching spell targeting the current cycle member.
Min remaining seconds of matching casts targeting cycle member.
Enemy casting a specific spell (by id) at the current cycle member. Use to heal the unit targeted by a named cast.
Enemy casting a specific spell (by normalized name) at the current cycle member.

groups.name: Buff List (Unit Auras)
groups.description: Scans a unit's buff list for known buff spell IDs from _aura.yaml buffs section. Default unit is player (unprefixed). Supports unit prefixes: target., focus., mouseover., cycle. Tags can be combined with dots for AND matching.

expressions.description: Player has any tracked buff active (from _aura.yaml buffs).
Player has no tracked buffs active.
Max remaining seconds of any tracked buff on player.
Count of active tracked buffs on player.
Player has a tracked buff with the given tag. Tags: immunity, major, minor, physical, magic, healing, parry, pvp.
Player has no tracked buff with the given tag.
Max remaining seconds of tag-filtered tracked buffs on player.
Count of tag-filtered active tracked buffs on player.
Player has a tracked buff matching ALL specified tags (AND logic).
Target has any tracked buff active.
Target has a tracked buff with the given tag.
Focus has a tracked buff with the given tag.
Mouseover has a tracked buff with the given tag.
Current cycle target has a tracked buff with the given tag.

groups.name: Debuff List
groups.description: Scans a unit's debuff list for known debuff spell IDs from _aura.yaml debuffs section. Supports unit prefixes: player (default), target, focus, mouseover, cycle. Tags can be combined with dots for AND matching.

expressions.description: Player has any tracked debuff active (from _aura.yaml debuffs).
Player has no tracked debuffs active.
Max remaining seconds of any tracked debuff on player.
Count of active tracked debuffs on player.
Player has a tracked debuff with the given tag. Tags: physical, magic, dot, bleed, heavy, curse, poison, disease, or any custom tag.
Player has no tracked debuff with the given tag.
Max remaining seconds of tag-filtered tracked debuffs on player.
Count of tag-filtered active tracked debuffs on player.
Player has a tracked debuff matching ALL specified tags (AND logic).
Target has any tracked debuff active.
Focus has a tracked debuff with the given tag.
Mouseover target has any tracked debuff active.
Current cycle target has a tracked debuff with the given tag.

categories.name: Incoming Damage Prediction
categories.description: Predicts the biggest incoming hit (enemy cast landing within ~0.3s, encounter-timeline ability within ~2s, or remaining damage of a player DoT) as a percent of effective health, for triggering defensives. Damage magnitude lives on _casts.yaml (cast `damage`) and _aura.yaml debuffs (`damage` = full DoT total, scaled by live remaining fraction); tags aoe/avoid/tank/trash drive targeting, exclusion, and M+ scaling.

groups.name: Aggregate (biggest predicted hit)
groups.description: Scans all sources and returns the single largest predicted threat. Excludes avoid-tagged (dodgeable) casts.

expressions.description: Biggest predicted incoming hit as % of effective health (health + absorb).
Raw (key-scaled) damage of the biggest predicted hit.
Seconds until the biggest predicted hit lands (0 for an active DoT).

groups.name: Mitigated (after my active defensives)
groups.description: Same prediction, scaled down by the player's currently-active defensives (self + external). Each defensive's DR (from _aura.yaml `dr:`) stacks multiplicatively; school-specific DR (e.g. Anti-Magic Shell) only applies when the hit's school matches. Gate a defensive suggestion on the raw form, then suppress follow-ups with the mitigated form.

expressions.description: Biggest predicted hit as % of effective health AFTER applying my active defensives.
Predicted hit damage after my active defensives' damage reduction.

groups.name: Per-spell
groups.description: Restricted to one spell id (numeric or resolvable name). The per-spell form also sees avoid-tagged casts that the aggregate excludes. Accepts the optional .mitigated modifier.

expressions.description: Predicted hit from one specific spell as % of effective health.
Raw key-scaled damage of one specific spell's predicted hit.
Seconds until one specific spell's predicted hit lands.
One specific spell's predicted hit as % of effective health after my active defensives.

categories.name: Variables
categories.description: User-defined rotation variables and config variables.

expressions.description: User-defined variable (from variables: section). Evaluated each tick.
Config variable (from config: section). Set by UI widgets.

categories.notes: Variables are defined in the rotation YAML variables: section as SimC expressions. Config variables generate UI widgets (sliders, checkboxes, dropdowns).

categories.name: Soft Interact
categories.description: Properties of the soft interact target (lootable corpses, NPCs).

categories.name: One Button Assistant
categories.description: Check if a one-button-assistant spell matches.

expressions.description: Seconds since one-button suggested this spell.

categories.name: System State
categories.description: Check app-level state flags.

yamlStructure.description: Rotation files are YAML with the following top-level structure.

topLevelKeys.name: spec
topLevelKeys.description: Spec ID for this rotation (e.g. 71 for Arms Warrior).

topLevelKeys.name: movement_allowed
topLevelKeys.description: SimC expression. When true, cast-time spells can be cast while moving.

topLevelKeys.name: spell_overrides
topLevelKeys.description: Global per-spell condition gates. Key: spell name, value: SimC expression AND-ed with every step that uses that spell.

topLevelKeys.name: config
topLevelKeys.description: Config variables that generate UI widgets.

topLevelKeys.name: variables
topLevelKeys.description: Named SimC expressions evaluated each tick. Reference with var.NAME.

topLevelKeys.name: tier_sets
topLevelKeys.description: Tier set definitions for set_bonus expressions.

topLevelKeys.name: lists
topLevelKeys.description: Named action lists. The 'main' list is the entry point.

configWidgetTypes.name: slider
configWidgetTypes.description: Numeric slider. Referenced as cfg.NAME (returns number).
configWidgetTypes.example:
energy_threshold:
  section: "Resources"
  type: slider
  min: 20
  max: 80
  value: 50

configWidgetTypes.name: checkbox
configWidgetTypes.description: Boolean toggle. Referenced as cfg.NAME (returns 0 or 1).

configWidgetTypes.name: dropdown
configWidgetTypes.description: Single selection dropdown. Referenced as cfg.NAME (returns selected option value).
configWidgetTypes.example:
burst_mode:
  type: dropdown
  options:
    - label: "Conservative"
      value: 1
    - label: "Aggressive"
      value: 2
  default: 0

configWidgetTypes.name: multi_select
configWidgetTypes.description: Multiple selection. Use cfg.NAME.has(VALUE) to check, cfg.NAME>=1 for count.
configWidgetTypes.example:
burst_tools:
  type: multi_select
  options:
    - label: "Trinket 1"
      value: 1
    - label: "Trinket 2"
      value: 2
  default: [0]

configWidgetTypes.name: unit_select
configWidgetTypes.description: Party/raid member selector. Use with cycle=config.NAME.
configWidgetTypes.example:
pi_target:
  type: unit_select
  filter: dps
  max: 1

configWidgetTypes.name: toggle
configWidgetTypes.description: Ephemeral boolean toggle. State always starts OFF and is never saved. Shows spell icon on overlay when active. Can be hotkeyed. Referenced as cfg.NAME (returns 0 or 1). show_override is always true.
configWidgetTypes.example:
reju_spread:
  type: toggle
  label: "Rejuvenation Spread"
  spell: 774
  description: "Spread Rejuvenation to group members missing the HoT"

configWidgetTypes.name: number
configWidgetTypes.description: Direct numeric entry (same data as slider, different widget). Referenced as cfg.NAME (returns number). If min and max are both 0, no clamping is applied. Aliases: number_input.
configWidgetTypes.example:
trinket_ilvl_min:
  section: "Items"
  type: number
  min: 0
  max: 999
  default: 600

configWidgetTypes.name: copy_text
configWidgetTypes.description: Read-only text with a Copy button. Display-only — never saved, not referencable in conditions. Useful for talent strings, WeakAura imports, macros. Aliases: copy, copytext, copy-text.
configWidgetTypes.example:
recommended_talents:
  section: "Talents"
  type: copy_text
  label: "Recommended Talent String"
  text: "B4PAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAESLDgZmlZGTbDsZmlZmZmZmlxMmZmlZ2YmFAA"

configWidgetTypes.name: link
configWidgetTypes.description: Button that opens a URL in the default browser. The label is the button text; the URL appears as a tooltip on hover. Display-only — never saved, not referencable in conditions. Alias: url.
configWidgetTypes.example:
guide_link:
  section: "Help"
  type: link
  label: "Open Guide"
  url: "https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps"

configWidgetTypes.name: note
configWidgetTypes.description: Static informational text block (wraps to width). Display-only — never saved, not referencable in conditions. Use for explanations longer than what fits in a description tooltip. Aliases: info, text.
configWidgetTypes.example:
pvp_note:
  section: "PvP"
  type: note
  label: "PvP rotation tips"
  text: "This APL assumes Gladiator's Medallion. Without one, enable manual_dispel and bind it."

configWidgetTypes.name: divider
configWidgetTypes.description: Horizontal separator line. Display-only — never saved, not referencable in conditions. Alias: separator.

configWidgetTypes.name: button
configWidgetTypes.description: Clickable button. If url is set, opens the URL. Otherwise, if text is set, copies it to the clipboard. Display-only — never saved, not referencable in conditions. The action field is reserved for future named-action dispatch.
configWidgetTypes.example:
copy_macro:
  section: "Macros"
  type: button
  label: "Copy interrupt macro"
  text: "/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][@target] Pummel"

specialActions.name: call_action_list,name=LIST
specialActions.description: Execute named list, then continue current list.

specialActions.name: run_action_list,name=LIST
specialActions.description: Execute named list, then restart rotation from top.

specialActions.name: return
specialActions.description: Stop processing current list (use with if= to conditionally skip).

stepModifiers.name: if
stepModifiers.description: SimC expression condition. Step only runs when this is true.

stepModifiers.name: range_check
stepModifiers.description: Which unit to range-check. Use 'none' for self-buffs or ground targeting.

stepModifiers.name: casting_check
stepModifiers.description: Require player to be casting. 'any' = any cast, or specify a spell. Skips isCurrentSpell guard.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_usable
stepModifiers.description: Skip usability check (cooldown + resource). Use for empowered spells.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_cooldown
stepModifiers.description: Skip only the cooldown check.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_movement
stepModifiers.description: Allow this cast-time spell while moving.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_queue
stepModifiers.description: Skip isCurrentSpell guard, allowing re-pressing to queue same spell. Use with interrupt for filler spam.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_blocked
stepModifiers.description: Bypass the full block gate: Enabled=off/block, CDs toggle off, and TTD gate are all ignored. Use sparingly — overrides the user's explicit disable/block.

stepModifiers.name: ignore_cds_toggle
stepModifiers.description: Bypass the block only when the reason is the global CDs toggle being off. User-disabled and TTD-gated spells still block. Pair with cooldown.X.is_cooldown so the line explicitly opts into firing a CD.

stepModifiers.name: interrupt
stepModifiers.description: Can interrupt current cast to use this spell.

stepModifiers.name: after
stepModifiers.description: Wait N milliseconds after condition becomes true before executing. Timer resets if condition goes false.

stepModifiers.name: delay
stepModifiers.description: Minimum milliseconds between presses of this spell.

stepModifiers.name: global_delay
stepModifiers.description: Block ALL spells for N ms after pressing (for channels that need time to register).

stepModifiers.name: cycle
stepModifiers.description: Iterate group members. Step runs on the lowest-HP match. Every group is LIVING members only, except cycle=dead, which iterates dead members nearest-first and is the only way a line can target a corpse (res / battle-res).

stepModifiers.name: cycle_order
stepModifiers.description: Override cycle iteration order. Default (health) sorts by raw HP ascending so squishy low-max-HP members come first (flat-damage triage); a 200k clothie outranks a 600k tank at the same HP%. Use health.pct for HP%-ascending order, player_first to check the player first, or buff/debuff.SPELL.remains to sort by aura duration ascending.

stepModifiers.name: target
stepModifiers.description: Cast on specific group member by role/health.

stepModifiers.name: override
stepModifiers.description: Use another spell's keybind for pressing.

stepModifiers.name: empower_to
stepModifiers.description: Auto-handle empowered spell: press to start empowering, press again at stage N to fire. Replaces manual casting_check+ignore_usable+ignore_cooldown+empower_stage workaround.

stepModifiers.name: hotkey
stepModifiers.description: Override keybind scan code.

stepModifiers.name: modifier
stepModifiers.description: Override key modifier (16=shift, 17=ctrl, 18=alt).

stepModifiers.name: resource
stepModifiers.description: Used with pool_resource: explicitly name the resource to reserve. All steps below this line that cost this resource will be skipped while the pool_resource condition is true.

stepModifiers.name: for_next
stepModifiers.description: Used with pool_resource: auto-detect the resource to reserve from the next N spell steps in the list. The target steps are exempt from being blocked themselves.

stepModifiers.name: off_gcd
stepModifiers.description: Mark step as off-GCD. Evaluated during GCD window and displayed as split icon overlay.

stepModifiers.name: line_cd
stepModifiers.description: Per-line cooldown in seconds. Prevents re-evaluation of this step for the specified duration after it activates.

stepModifiers.name: snapshot
stepModifiers.description: Auto-capture a diagnostic snapshot when this step is suggested. File named SpellName_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.log with full cache + rotation trace. Fires once per suggestion, resets when a different spell is suggested.

actionTypes.name: one_button_assist
actionTypes.description: Press the one-button assistant keybind directly.

actionTypes.name: one_button_assist_lookup
actionTypes.description: Look up and press the keybind for the spell suggested by the one-button assistant.

actionTypes.name: pool_resource
actionTypes.description: Resource reservation gate. When its condition is true, marks a resource as reserved so lower-priority steps that would spend it are skipped. Use resource= to name the resource explicitly, or for_next=N to auto-detect it from the next N spell steps. The directly targeted spell (for_next) is exempt from the block. Never produces a suggestion — only controls what fires below it.
